sections.title: Why Convert PDF to Word Locally?
sections.content: Traditional online converters upload your confidential files to remote cloud servers. HandleMyFile executes the entire conversion locally in browser memory using WebAssembly, ensuring your contracts, financial statements, and private records never leave your device.

sections.title: How to Convert PDF to Word in 3 Steps

steps.title: Select or Drop PDF
steps.description: Choose your PDF document. The file is read directly into your device RAM without uploading.

steps.title: Intelligent Layout Extraction

steps.title: Download Editable DOCX
steps.description: Instantly save your converted Word file, ready to open in Microsoft Word, Google Docs, or LibreOffice.

sections.title: Enterprise-Grade Document Confidentiality
sections.content: Engineered for legal counsel, accountants, researchers, and enterprises who cannot risk uploading proprietary documents to third-party SaaS servers. Complies with GDPR Article 25 (Privacy by Design) and HIPAA data isolation guidelines.
sections.subTitle: Unhackable In-RAM Execution
sections.subContent: Once you close the browser tab, all document buffers are automatically purged from system memory.

sections.title: Pure Zero-Egress Network Isolation
sections.content: You can even disconnect your Wi-Fi or turn on Airplane Mode after loading the page: the PDF to Word converter continues to operate with 100% functionality completely offline.

sections.title: Instant In-Memory OpenXML Generation
sections.content: Say goodbye to waiting in server queues or downloading huge attachments. Convert multi-page PDFs to clean, editable Word documents in milliseconds directly on your hardware.

faqs.q: Can I edit the converted document in Microsoft Word and Google Docs?
faqs.a: Yes. The output is a standard OpenXML (.docx) file fully compatible with Microsoft Word 2007 through 365, Google Docs, LibreOffice Writer, and Apple Pages.

faqs.q: Are my documents uploaded to any remote server?
faqs.a: No. HandleMyFile operates under a strict Zero-Egress policy. All parsing, text clustering, and DOCX generation happen 100% inside your web browser sandbox.

faqs.q: Does this tool work completely offline without internet?
faqs.a: Yes. Once the application assets are cached in your browser, you can convert PDFs to Word documents without an active internet connection.

faqs.q: Is there any file size limit, page limit, or mandatory registration?
faqs.a: There are no artificial paywalls, watermarks, or user registrations required. The only limit is your device available RAM.

faqs.q: Will bold, italic, and font headings be preserved?
faqs.a: Yes. Our spatial analyzer detects font weights, styles, and font sizes to maintain your headings, bold emphasis, and italic styling in the converted Word document.
